title: Estimation Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Estimation Engineer to join our team in Maharashtra. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in cost estimation and a keen eye for detail. As an Estimation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the planning and execution of projects by providing accurate cost estimates that align with project specifications and client expectations. Key Responsibilities: \- Develop and prepare detailed cost estimates for various projects, ensuring accuracy and completeness. \- Analyze project requirements and specifications to determine the necessary resources and costs involved. \- Collaborate with project managers and other stakeholders to gather relevant information and clarify project details. \- Monitor and review project costs throughout the lifecycle to ensure adherence to budget constraints. \- Provide recommendations for cost\-saving measures and efficiency improvements. \- Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of industry trends, materials, and techniques to enhance estimation processes. Required Skills: \- Strong expertise in cost estimation and analysis. \- Proficiency in estimation software and tools. \- Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills. \- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with team members and clients. \- Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. If you are a motivated individual with a passion for cost estimation and a desire to contribute to successful project outcomes, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join us in delivering high\-quality projects that meet our clients' needs and expectations.

title: Senior Quantity Surveyor
description:
Vacancy Introduction
   

  

 Haskoning is an independent consulting engineering company that is dedicated to creating a positive impact on people and planet. Backed by the expertise of over 6,000 colleagues working from offices in more than 20 countries, and with more than 140 years of experience under our belt, we are helping clients with challenges ranging from climate change and digital transformation to changing customer demands and the energy transition. Driven by our mission Enhancing Society Together, we believe that each and every one of us holds the power to deliver measurable positive impact on society through our projects, and in our own operations
   

  

 What will you do
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Verify EPC Contractor measurements and certify quantities as per contract requirements.
* Review IPCs, bills, milestone claims, and recommend payments.
* Monitor project costs, budgets, cash flow, and cost variances.
* Verify quantity calculations, reconciliations, and material consumption.
* Assess variations, change orders, additional works, and claims.
* Maintain records of quantities, payments, variations, and claims.
* Verify measurements for civil, utility, electrical, and treatment plant works.
* Review revised quantities, rate analyses, and cost adjustment proposals.
* Support contract administration for measurements, payments, and variations.
* Monitor scope changes, quantity growth, and commercial risks.
* Conduct site inspections and joint measurements with stakeholders.
* Review measurement records and supporting documentation.
* Prepare cost estimates, variation assessments, and quantity forecasts.
* Coordinate with project teams for timely processing of commercial matters.
* Prepare periodic quantity, cost, variation, and payment reports.


 Where you will work
   

  

 Roha, Raigad
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering.
* Minimum 15 years of professional experience, with 12 years of experience in a quantity surveying role.
* Postgraduate qualification in Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Contracts Management, or Project Management shall be preferred.
* Professional certification in Quantity Surveying, Cost Engineering, Contracts Management, or related disciplines shall be desirable.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, AutoCAD, and quantity measurement software.
* Knowledge of FIDIC, EPC Contracts, CPWD Specifications, MoRTH Specifications, and standard methods of measurement.
* Good report writing skills.
* Good communication skills in English and Hindi.


 What we offer you
   

  

* Market competitive salary
* Experience in an employee friendly work culture
* Insurance cover for self and family
* Social Security
* Paid leaves
* Group Profit Sharing


 Are you our new colleague?

The application process then consists of 1\-2 interviews and a possibly assessment. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!

title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description** 
 S KUSHALCHAND INTERNATIONAL PVT. LTD. (SKIL) is a century\-old chemical distribution company supporting India’s key industries through global sourcing partnerships and technical expertise. Founded in 1922, SKIL has grown from distributing Monsanto Vanillin to connecting leading international manufacturers with top Indian companies in Food \& Flavour, Personal Care, Pharma, Nutraceuticals, Coatings, and Specialty Chemicals. With a team of 40\+ professionals, the company serves over 650 customers across India, backed by pan\-India supply chain, warehousing, and a broad portfolio of premium ingredients and intermediates. SKIL is recognized in ICIS rankings as a Global Top 300 and Asia\-Pacific Top 100 Chemical Distributor, reflecting its strong performance and market presence. The company continues to expand through strategic partnerships with major global brands in aroma performance, nutrition, and specialty ingredients.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Accountant role based in Goregaon. The Accountant will manage day\-to\-day accounting operations, including recording transactions, maintaining general ledgers, reconciling bank and vendor accounts, and preparing invoices and credit notes. The role involves supporting month\-end and year\-end closing activities, assisting with financial statements and management reports, and ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax regulations, and internal policies. The Accountant will coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders for documentation, payments, collections, and audit requirements, while helping improve accounting processes and accuracy of financial data.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong knowledge of core accounting principles and practices, including general ledger management, account reconciliation, and financial reporting.
* Proficiency with accounting and ERP software, MS Excel, and basic data analysis for financial records and reports.
* Understanding of taxation, GST, TDS, and statutory compliance relevant to corporate accounting in India.
* Attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and the ability to manage documentation and records systematically.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross\-functional teams, vendors, and auditors.
* Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and maintain confidentiality of financial information.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Commerce, Finance, or a related field; professional qualifications (e.g., CA Inter, CMA) are an advantage.
* Experience in distribution, manufacturing, or chemicals industry is beneficial but not mandatory.

title: Associate Accountant (Fund Administration)
description:
**About Us**
 HC Global Fund Services, LLC (“HC Global”) is a privately owned fund administrator serving fund managers and investment advisors in the alternative investments industry.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Duties and Responsibilities:**
*Middle and Back Office Functions*
* Gathers all information required (i.e. external statements, i.e., prime broker reports and custodian statements, supporting documents for recurring expenses including legal fees, audit fee, admin fees, tax fees, director’s fee, etc.).
* For Geneva clients, performs pricing of funds’ investments using prices from external sources.
* Uploads daily trade transactions from the prime broker’s FTP sites or trade blotter including the daily dividends, interest, corporate actions, and cash activities and record them in the HC Global’s portfolio accounting.
* Prepares daily equity reconciliation for each fund and if required by the engagement, also prepares position and cash reconciliation.
* Investigates any trade breaks and reconciling items on the reconciliation
* Based on downloaded reports and other calculations, prepares and/or updates the financial reports (trial balance, income statement, balance sheet, statement of changes in capital accounts, investors’ monthly and YTD allocations, capital letters, summary of expenses, schedule of management fees, etc.).
* Ensures that the monthly partners’ allocation is allocating the correct profit and loss based on the straight capital ratios or commitment ratios, whichever is the case maybe.
* Ensures that management fees and performance fees are allocating according to the limited partnership agreements.
* Ensures that all expenses are accrued, and all income and expense items are recognized in the appropriate tabs in the allocation file.
* Ensures that all income and expenses are classified in the right income and expense character for income tax purposes.
* Ensures the correctness of the monthly, quarterly and year to date gross and net returns for each limited partner.
* Ensures that all working papers are appropriately labeled and with proper notations and/or cell comments.
* Prepares the reporting package for next level review.
* Prepares all accounting related entries for Geneva clients, ensuring that all transactions have appropriate support.
* Monitors client mailboxes/distribution lists and saves all necessary emails and supports on a timely manner.
* Prepares ad hoc requests received from client, including but not limited to, distributions, drawdowns, etc.
* Prepares wire entries in the treasury portal for engagements with Cash Control services.
* Performs peer review of Investor statements, as needed.


*Assists in coordinating annual audits of clients’ financial statements.*
* Prepares working papers in a way that ensures that all audit requirements are handy for the auditors.
* Prepares year\-end schedules for independent auditors including cost roll forward, cash reconciliation, statement of cash flows, and financial highlights and other working papers supporting the balances and disclosures in the financial statements.
* Prepares each fund’s financial statements and works closely with the respective fund’s auditors for note disclosures.
* Prepares and submits draft financial statements on a timely basis for next level review.
* Organizes own work, setting priorities and meeting critical deadlines.


**Requirements**
**Job Specifications:**
* Graduate of Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy
* Preferably a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or Chartered Accountant (CA)
* Preferably with at least 1 year of experience in financial accounting or equivalent
* A team player; must be able to work individually and as part of a team
* Has a good business understanding of financial concepts and procedures
* Analytical and very detail\-oriented
* Flexibility to expand work hours as necessary and support business needs
* Non\-CPAs are welcome to apply


**Benefits**
 To be discussed during the application process.
